We had a very disappointing experience with CodeVista. Despite spending a significant amount of money, their services did not meet our expectations. The staff lacked professionalism and there appeared to be no permanent team in place, leading to inconsistent quality. Adherence to deadlines was a major issue, as they failed to meet agreed time limits. Moreover, their ability to create and implement a website effectively was lacking.

The company even requested us to post positive reviews, which suggests that some of the good ratings may not be genuine. However, we believe in being honest, so we cannot recommend CodeVista. If you’re looking for reliable and skilled website development, consider other options

We had a highly disappointing experience with CodeVista. The project timelines were consistently missed, and their staff lacked professionalism and expertise. The company appears to rely on temporary staff, who do not have the necessary skills to create or implement websites effectively. Despite significant investment on our part, we did not receive a satisfactory product. Additionally, we felt pressured by them to leave positive reviews, which raises concerns about the authenticity of their ratings. Due to these issues, we strongly do not recommend CodeVista for any web development needs.

Our experience with CodeVista was absolutely terrible. From start to finish, their service was a disaster. The staff is neither professional nor skilled, and it was clear that they don’t have a permanent team in place. Deadlines meant nothing to them, and they failed to deliver on time, despite charging premium prices. It was shocking how poorly they handled basic client interactions and how little they knew about proper website development and implementation.

After spending a lot of money, we were left with subpar results and frustration. To make matters worse, they even pressured us to leave a positive review—it's likely that many of the glowing reviews you see are coerced or fake. We value honesty, so we refuse to sugarcoat our experience: CodeVista was an utter disappointment, and we strongly advise against using their services. Save your time, money, and peace of mind by going elsewhere

I’ve been trying to reach this agency for over two weeks! Multiple emails and phone calls, but no response at all. As a business actively seeking a marketing partner, I expected at least some acknowledgment or follow-up. Unfortunately, the lack of communication raises concerns about reliability and professionalism. I’m disappointed, especially considering the positive reviews that influenced my decision to contact them in the first place.

My response to their reply:
Thank you for your reply. I understand that you are a boutique agency, but that does not excuse two weeks of silence across multiple channels (contact forms, emails, and phone calls)

After your reply to this review, I made another effort to reach out by both phone and email. Unfortunately, your phone system still says no one is available, and I have not received any reply to my follow up email, not even an automated acknowledgment.

The fact that I received a quick response here, but not through direct channels, suggests that monitoring Google reviews takes priority over actual client communication. That is concerning for any potential partner.

Lastly, accusing someone of leaving a fake review based solely on the name used on Google is unnecessary. Many people use partial names online for privacy. That kind of assumption came across as defensive and unprofessional, especially given that I was making a legitimate inquiry.

I was genuinely interested in working with your agency, but the continued lack of response and the tone of your reply have only confirmed my concerns. I hope this feedback encourages improvements in how inquiries are handled moving forward.

I engaged Jives Media after a three-month search for a suitable Google Ads agency, initially attracted by their promises of expertise and a tailored approach. Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing, and the results did not reflect the $4,700 per month we invested in their services.

From the start, there were significant issues with their approach and recommendations. One of our key concerns was the suggestion to change our main campaign’s bid strategy from Target Impression Share to Maximise Conversions without conducting an A/B test. As someone experienced in Google Ads, I know that changing a bid strategy is one of the most significant shifts you can make within a campaign, and it should never be done without proper testing. Jay described this change as "baby steps," but the suggestion revealed a clear disconnect in understanding and a concerning lack of expertise from the team.

Adding to this, the team recommended pausing bids for the search term “eyelash extension course,” which is literally the core product we sell. This recommendation was not only baffling but showed an evident lack of understanding of our business and goals. We had expected a partner with a sound strategy aligned with our business needs, but these suggestions showed the opposite.

Our concerns were repeatedly ignored or mishandled, leading to a further breakdown of trust. I specifically requested to speak directly with Jay, the CEO, to address these strategy concerns and discuss his team’s experience with accounts of our scale. Instead, Jay brought additional team members, preventing an open discussion about these issues. The lack of regard for our requests as a new client left us feeling undervalued and sidelined.

Further adding to the frustration, Jives Media regularly took days to respond to our emails, even as a new client. In an industry where timing and communication are critical, this lack of responsiveness only deepened our dissatisfaction.

On the technical side, Jives Media was contractually responsible for conducting market analysis and competitive research during their onboarding process. Instead, we were asked to provide our own list of competitors and revenue data, which they could have easily accessed within our Google Ads account. This failure to carry out basic responsibilities reinforced our view that they were not doing the necessary work to manage our account effectively.

Additionally, when it came to landing page optimisations, I had made it very clear that 90% of our traffic came from mobile users. Despite this, we received recommendations based solely on desktop performance. This oversight showed a clear lack of attention to detail and was another instance of them not fully comprehending or accommodating our business needs.

After expressing our dissatisfaction and intent to part ways, we were met with legal involvement from their team. I had hoped for an open conversation directly with Jay, business owner to business owner, to resolve matters amicably, but instead, I received an email from their billing department with legal threats. This approach was both unexpected and disappointing, especially after I had clearly stated in writing that we did not intend to share our experience publicly.

In short, Jives Media’s strategy, responsiveness, and lack of attention to detail did not reflect the professional service they promoted during initial discussions. For $4,700 a month, we expected a knowledgeable, proactive partner, yet the reality fell far short of that standard. Businesses looking for a Google Ads partner should proceed with caution, as our experience highlighted serious issues with both their strategy and client service.
